sampling.large_fill: formal trade and FillLots >= max(20, D-1 same-side q95)
sampling.md_first_visit: B1 or A1 moves by at least half a tick and the integer (B1, A1) pair is first seen in the current RecordHigh epoch

candidate_family.correction: BH within each directional label over all 12 fixed candidates

sparse_screen.ranking: lowest within-label BH q, then largest equal-day delta-z
sparse_screen.fallback: if no candidate clears every gate, dense-check the lowest raw HAC p candidate only as a labeled falsification check, not as a discovery

dense_check.acceptance: positive full-period equal-day delta-z with HAC p < 0.05, positive 2025 and 2026 effects, and positive-month ratio >= 0.60

causal_exclusions: future price or future profit fields
